GAP ECFC Exported Types

group GAP_ECFC_Exported_Types

Enums

enum T_GAP_ECFC_STATE

L2CAP ECFC channel Connection State.

Values:

enumerator GAP_ECFC_STATE_DISCONNECTED

Disconnected.

enumerator GAP_ECFC_STATE_CONNECTED

Connected.

enumerator GAP_ECFC_STATE_DISCONNECTING

Disconnecting.

enum T_GAP_ECFC_PARAM_TYPE

GAP ECFC Parameter List.

Values:

enumerator GAP_ECFC_PARAM_INIT_CREDITS

Local initial credits. Write only. Size is 2 octets. Default value is 4.

enumerator GAP_ECFC_PARAM_LOCAL_MPS

Local MPS. Write only. Size is 2 octets. Default value is 245.

enum T_GAP_ECFC_CONN_CFM_CAUSE

L2CAP ECFC connection confirm cause used in gap_ecfc_send_conn_cfm API.

Values:

enumerator GAP_ECFC_CONN_ACCEPT

All connections accept.

enumerator GAP_ECFC_CONN_NO_RESOURCES

Some connections refused:insufficient resources available.

enumerator GAP_ECFC_CONN_UNACCEPTABLE_PARAMS

All connections refused:unacceptable parameters.

enumerator GAP_ECFC_CONN_INVALID_PARAMS

All connections refused:invalid parameters.

enumerator GAP_ECFC_CONN_PENDING_NO_INFO

All connections pending:no further information available.

enumerator GAP_ECFC_CONN_PENDING_AUTHOR

All connections pending:authorization pending.

enum T_GAP_ECFC_RCFG_CFM_CAUSE

L2CAP reconfigure confirm cause used in GAP_ECFC_RECONFIGURE_IND callback.

Values:

enumerator GAP_ECFC_RCFG_ACCEPT

All connections accept.

enumerator GAP_ECFC_RCFG_UNACCEPTABLE_PARAMS

Reconfiguration failed - other unacceptable parameters.

enum T_GAP_ECFC_MSG

Values:

enumerator GAP_ECFC_PROTO_REG_RSP

Response msg type for gap_ecfc_reg_proto. The structure of callback data is T_GAP_ECFC_PROTO_REG_RSP.

enumerator GAP_ECFC_SEC_REG_RSP

Response msg type for gap_ecfc_send_sec_reg_req. The structure of callback data is T_GAP_ECFC_SEC_REG_RSP.

enumerator GAP_ECFC_CONN_IND

Indication msg type for receiving L2CAP ECFC connection request from remote device. APP shall call gap_ecfc_send_conn_cfm when receiving this msg. The structure of callback data is T_GAP_ECFC_CONN_IND.

enumerator GAP_ECFC_CONN_RSP

Response msg type for gap_ecfc_send_conn_req. The structure of callback data is T_GAP_ECFC_CONN_RSP.

enumerator GAP_ECFC_CONN_CMPL

Information msg type for L2CAP ECFC connection establish result. The structure of callback data is T_GAP_ECFC_CONN_CMPL_INFO.

enumerator GAP_ECFC_DATA_IND

Indication msg type for receiving L2CAP ECFC data from remote device. The structure of callback data is T_GAP_ECFC_DATA_IND.

enumerator GAP_ECFC_DATA_RSP

Response msg type for gap_ecfc_send_data_req. The structure of callback data is T_GAP_ECFC_DATA_RSP.

enumerator GAP_ECFC_DISCONN_IND

Indication msg type for receiving L2CAP disconnection request from remote device. The structure of callback data is T_GAP_ECFC_DISCONN_IND.

enumerator GAP_ECFC_DISCONN_RSP

Response msg type for gap_ecfc_send_disconn_req. The structure of callback data is T_GAP_ECFC_DISCONN_RSP.

enumerator GAP_ECFC_RECONFIGURE_IND

Indication msg type for receiving ECFC reconfigure request from remote device. The structure of callback data is T_GAP_ECFC_RECONFIGURE_IND.

enumerator GAP_ECFC_RECONFIGURE_RSP

Response msg type for gap_ecfc_send_reconfigure_req. The structure of callback data is T_GAP_ECFC_RECONFIGURE_RSP.

struct T_GAP_ECFC_PROTO_REG_RSP

Response of registering protocol over L2CAP. It will be received in the callback function registered by gap_ecfc_reg_proto with message type as GAP_ECFC_PROTO_REG_RSP.

Public Members

bool is_le

Whether using LE transport.

uint16_t proto_id

Protocol ID assigned by GAP ECFC Module.

uint16_t psm

PSM of the protocol.

uint16_t cause

Result of registering protocol to L2CAP layer.

struct T_GAP_ECFC_CONN_IND

Indication of remote L2CAP ECFC connection request. It will be received in the callback function registered by gap_ecfc_reg_proto with message type as GAP_ECFC_CONN_IND.

Public Members

uint16_t proto_id

Protocol ID assigned by GAP ECFC Module.

uint16_t conn_handle

Connection handle.

uint16_t remote_mtu

Remote MTU value.

uint8_t cid_num

The number of the L2CAP ECFC channels request to establish.

uint16_t cid[5]

Local Channel Identifier array assigned by Bluetooth Host.

uint8_t bd_addr[6]

Bluetooth address of remote device.

uint8_t bd_type

Bluetooth address type of remote device. Value is T_GAP_REMOTE_ADDR_TYPE.

uint16_t identity_id

Identity ID for gap_ecfc_send_conn_cfm.

struct T_GAP_ECFC_CONN_RSP

Response of starting L2CAP ECFC connection request. It will be received in the callback function registered by gap_ecfc_reg_proto with message type as GAP_ECFC_CONN_RSP.

Public Members

uint16_t proto_id

Protocol ID assigned by GAP ECFC Module.

uint8_t cid_num

The number of the L2CAP ECFC channels request to establish.

uint16_t cause

Result of executing L2CAP ECFC connection request.

uint8_t bd_addr[6]

Bluetooth address of remote device.

uint8_t bd_type

Bluetooth address type of remote device. Value is T_GAP_REMOTE_ADDR_TYPE.

struct T_GAP_ECFC_CONN_CMPL_INFO

Information of L2CAP ECFC channel establish result. It will be received in the callback function registered by gap_ecfc_reg_proto with message type as GAP_ECFC_CONN_CMPL.

Public Members

uint16_t proto_id

Protocol ID assigned by GAP ECFC Module.

uint16_t cause

Result of establishing a L2CAP ECFC channels with remote device.

uint16_t conn_handle

Connection handle.

uint8_t cid_num

The number of the L2CAP ECFC channels successfully established.

uint16_t cid[5]

Local Channel Identifier array assigned by Bluetooth Host.

uint16_t remote_mtu

Remote MTU value.

uint16_t local_mtu

Local MTU value.

uint16_t local_mps

Local MPS value.

uint16_t ds_data_offset

Offset used to fill user data when sending L2CAP data to remote.

uint8_t bd_addr[6]

Bluetooth address of remote device.

uint8_t bd_type

Bluetooth address type of remote device. Value is T_GAP_REMOTE_ADDR_TYPE.

struct T_GAP_ECFC_DATA_IND

Indication of L2CAP data received from remote side. It will be received in the callback function registered by gap_ecfc_reg_proto with message type as GAP_ECFC_DATA_IND.

Public Members

uint16_t proto_id

Protocol ID assigned by GAP ECFC Module.

uint16_t conn_handle

Connection handle.

uint16_t cid

Local Channel Identifier assigned by Bluetooth Host.

uint16_t length

Length of L2CAP data.

uint16_t gap

Offset from data parameter to the real L2CAP data.

uint8_t data[1]

The rest of message which contains real L2CAP data at offset of gap.

struct T_GAP_ECFC_DATA_RSP

Public Members

uint16_t proto_id

Protocol ID assigned by GAP ECFC Module.

uint16_t conn_handle

Connection handle.

uint16_t cid

Local Channel Identifier assigned by Bluetooth Host.

uint16_t cause

Result of sending data.
